issues.description: Method Client.assembleBookstore: the problem statement describes and tests expect assembleBookstore to produce/return a Bookstore (it instructs to "Implement assembleBookstore which creates a Bookstore" and the template contains a commented signature returning Bookstore). The solution defines the method as `private static func assembleBookstore() -> String` but its implementation constructs and returns a Bookstore instance. This mismatch between the declared return type (String) in the solution and the expected return type (Bookstore) in the problem statement and template will cause a compilation error and confuses students about the intended signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's method signature to return a Bookstore to match the problem statement and template: `private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... }` and keep the existing `return Bookstore(books: books)` implementation. This will restore type consistency and allow the code to compile.
